text: {"status":"answered","premise":"none","claims":[{"text":"The quarterly budget table lists a total development budget of $1,700,000 across all four quarters.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s1","quote":"Total | $1,700,000 | $460,000 | $240,000 | $2,400,000"}]},{"text":"The per-quarter development figures are $450,000, $500,000, $400,000 and $350,000, which sum to $1,700,000.","kind":"derived","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s1","quote":"Q1 2027 | $450,000 | $120,000 | $60,000 | $630,000"},{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s1","quote":"Q2 2027 | $500,000 | $150,000 | $70,000 | $720,000"},{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s1","quote":"Q3 2027 | $400,000 | $100,000 | $60,000 | $560,000"},{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s1","quote":"Q4 2027 | $350,000 | $90,000 | $50,000 | $490,000"}]},{"text":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown notes that these figures reflect the originally approved budget and that the overall project budget was later adjusted, without giving a revised development figure.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s2","quote":"Note that the figures above reflect the originally approved budget."}]},{"text":"The documents don't state a revised development-only budget after that adjustment.","kind":"absence","evidence":[]}],"conflicts":[],"missing":[],"clarifying_question":"","clarify_options":[]}
